title: Quote of the day by Marcus Aurelius: 'It is not death that should be feared, but we should fear never beginning to live' - Lesson on importance of being fearless in life by the ancient Stoic philosopher
description: Roman emperor and Stoic philosopher Marcus Aurelius believed that people should fear wasting their lives more than death itself. In his book Meditations, he reflected on mortality, purpose and the importance of living in the present. His philosophy encouraged people to stop worrying excessively about the past and future and focus instead on living with justice, purpose and awareness.

title: Ancient 'rusty treasure' emerges from river with enough iron to forge 500 swords
description: Over 500 iron bars pulled from the Danube River in Austria may point to a shipwreck that sank a massive Iron Age cargo over 2,000 years ago, researchers say.
